text: Our intent is to build a sports betting syndicate period point blank. This misconception comes up quite a bit so I want to take some time and to address it head on and to show you why it is a misconception. So first and foremost, we are betting our own picks. We are betting a $65,000 bankroll. I am personally in charge of $33,000 of that bankroll. And here's the proof. Instead of changing it to units, we can look at how much we're actually betting. You can see that this Saturday we have almost $5,000 in play. On NFL Sunday we have about $3,000. You can see the net winnings and losings each week. Remember, I'm personally betting $33,000. What do you know? This stuff, $333, which is 1%. We've been very transparent about what our unit sizing is for NFL versus college. Just like our wins and losses, we are fully transparent. But the reason this is a misconception that people don't understand is how much money you can bet when you're betting on main sides and totals and how much capital is required to be betting those to make money or to be profitable full time. As you can see here at Open, you can bet $5,000 in the NFL. And at Open, you can bet $3,000 in college. So to put that in context, we feel very confident that we can beat opening lines. In order to maximize how much money we can be ultimately betting, we would need $800,000 in cash to be maximally betting our edge, meaning we can be opening lines. And in order to get down the maximum amount of money on those opens, we would need to have $800,000 in liquid cash. As much as people are going to or willing to lie to you what they think this looks like, it is very difficult to obtain $800,000 in cash. Even if you have an edge, we can talk about the math. Cash on cash return on a model getting around 80 picks in the NFL and 150 picks in college is going to return you if you win about 55% on those bets, about 15% cash on cash return. Now, if you can get more volume, you can turn over your bankroll faster. But even with a $65,000 bankroll, we're multiple years away from being able to maximize how much we can bet or the maximum amount we should be betting based off our edge. We're years away from being able to max that out. So in lieu of this, we have information that wins. We are betting this. Yes, we sell access to the same information. We're also small enough of a syndicate where we're not moving the lines because we're not betting and market making books yet. And so our clients can get the same numbers we can get at open. But I want to be as transparent as possible. So let's talk about the actual numbers. You can see our traffic to our website. We get a very healthy amount because we have a bunch of free data. In paid revenue, we've made $7,400 this season by selling access to the model. We are betting more. I personally, just me, I'm betting more this weekend than how much we've made all year selling access to the model. Selling the model does two things. It allows us to raise capital, but you can see that we're already raising capital ourselves and betting as much as we possibly can. And two, it allows us to do this on stage and in front of everybody. And so that we can hopefully attract people that can allow us to bet larger and we can raise capital. And ultimately, yes, we will have to go private because the information that we have is more valuable than what we're selling it for. But that's how a market works, guys. You don't just hop on an app and then all of a sudden you move markets and people believe you win, especially in this industry when every Tom, Dick and Harry is a winner, has a skill, knows what they're doing, can do something you can't do. The reality is we have to do it in this fashion or else we are just leaving money on the table that we could be using to bet and we're not putting our names out there in order to get the buzz and the eyeballs of people that can help us get to where we need to go. This is what building a professional syndicate looks like, guys. It is not all glory and just sexiness and Lambos and this, that and the other. It takes an insane amount of capital to make good money. And the reality is we actually have the skills we talk about. We make really good money in our nine to five lives. And so it takes an insane large amount of capital for us to be able to bet that in order to leave that situation. So for now, this is what we're doing as a business to maximize our profit in order to bet as much as we possibly can. And so that's what transparency looks like, guys. This is what we are. This is who we are. We are not running from anything. We are fully transparent about all of our picks, our win records, our loss records, what we're doing, what our intent is. And we're trying to do that on the stage for you guys. And hopefully you can see that that is who and what we are. And as always, good guys, good luck and let us know if you have any other questions.
